title: Documents
description: Presentation, concept note, appendices. Anything that helps the committee judge the file, and nothing that replaces it: the detailed presentation remains the main part.
pendingUpload: Files will be sent to our servers when the submission is sent. They are checked — format, size, virus scan — before being kept.

empty.title: No document attached
empty.description: This step is optional. A submission without attachments is perfectly acceptable.

public.label: Make this document public
public.hint: It will appear on the activity page once the activity is selected and published. Leave off for a document meant for the committee only.

errors.titleRequired: Give a title to the document “{file}”.
errors.fileType: The file “{file}” is not in an accepted format.
errors.fileTooLarge: The file “{file}” exceeds the maximum allowed size.
